views.rationale: AMZN's sales growth is 20% driven by customer usage, while BAC's Global Markets revenue decreased 72 million.
BA's cost of sales decreased 10% due to lower revenue and lower reach-forward losses, while CAT's sales volume decreased 7% in the third quarter.
CVX's sales and other operating revenues decreased $7.33 billion due to lower refined product, crude oil, and natural gas prices.
NVDA's gross margin improved 1.2% in Q3, while MSFT's gross margin improved 18%
PG's gross margin increased 180 basis points to 51.0%, while NEE's gross margin was relatively flat
UNH's cash flows decreased due to changes in working capital accounts, while PFE's cost of sales as a percentage of revenues increased 0.7 percentage points
WMT's operating expenses as a percentage of net sales decreased 21 basis points, while XOM's earnings were reduced by $1,140 million due to weaker margins.
